'''Randy Koruschak''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 6th at [[April 2000 Kingsport tournament]] on 29 April 2000, according to Brody Hughes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d622">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-kingsport-tennessee-4-29-99-brody-s-trd622/ kingsport-tennessee-4-29-99-brody-s-tr], DeckTech (Brody "Short_Punk" Hughes, 29 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-kingsport-tennessee-4-29-99-brody-s-trd622/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
